name: What should homeowners decide before planning a separate living space?
description: Clarify occupant mobility needs, desired privacy, kitchen and bathroom features, and locate your existing electrical panel and plumbing lines.

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners decide before planning a separate living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a contractor, clarify who will occupy the suite, their specific mobility requirements, and your preferred location on the property. Consider whether the occupant needs accessible bathroom features like a walk-in shower, how much kitchen functionality is required, and whether a private exterior entrance is necessary. It is also helpful to review your property survey to understand lot lines and identify where existing plumbing and electrical panels sit, as tie-in distances significantly influence construction complexity and layout options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clarify occupant mobility needs, desired privacy, kitchen and bathroom features, and locate your existing electrical panel and plumbing lines.
